provenance.description: The source left-arm shoulder subtree and its internal tendon relationships.
provenance.note: Source joint frames and component identity retained. Simplified display geometry, curated finishes and illustrative separation. Only a rigid whole-arm swivel is animated; internal closed-linkage joints remain fixed. Not a solved linkage, walking simulation or manufacturing release.
